rule: same family, same order, continue from the first box the frozen run never reached
note: one() only saved inside the attempt loop, so the case that stopped on the clock left a file reading UNKNOWN/timed_out=false while the process printed TIMEOUT. The final save and `finalize` were added afterwards; the attempt lists were written incrementally during the run and are unchanged. `finalize` re-derives status from (attempts, family size, elapsed), the same rule one() now writes.
